name: Mushroom Yield Calculator
seoDesc: Mushroom yield is reported as biological efficiency: kilograms of fresh mushrooms per 100 kg of dry substrate. Free mushroom yield calculator: enter your valu
summary:
Mushroom yield is reported as biological efficiency: kilograms of fresh mushrooms per 100 kg of dry substrate. It returns biological efficiency, wet substrate weight, yield per block and blocks for a 100 kg harvest, and the panel shows all of them at once.

This calculator converts your harvest and substrate weights into BE, the yield per block and the number of blocks a target harvest needs. Press Calculate and the results appear in the grey boxes; after the first press they keep up with every edit, so there is no page to reload. Units are stated on every box and in every result, so a figure copied out of a protocol, a datasheet or a chart can be entered without converting it first.

sections.title: The formula behind the Mushroom Yield
sections.html:
BE (%) = fresh mushroom weight ÷ dry substrate weight × 100

The symbols in the formula
SymbolWhat it stands forUnit
freshfresh mushrooms harvestedkg
dry substratesubstrate dry matter at spawningkg
BEbiological efficiency%

sections.title: How do I use the Mushroom Yield?
sections.html:
Every input sits in the same order the formula is written, so the page reads like the equation.

  1. Enter the values you already have. Every box accepts a decimal point and a minus sign; thousands separators are ignored.
  2. The grey boxes are results: they are worked out from your inputs and cannot be typed into.
  3. Press Calculate. The results fill in together, and from then on they follow every edit you make — there is no page to reload and nothing to submit.

sections.title: A worked example
sections.html:
Take the default values the page opens with: fresh mushrooms harvested of 18 kg, substrate dry weight of 10 kg, substrate moisture of 65%, number of blocks of 10.

Substituting them into the formula gives biological efficiency of 180%, wet substrate weight of 28.57 kg, yield per block of 1.8 kg, blocks for a 100 kg harvest of 55.56 blocks.

Those numbers come from the same solver the page runs in your browser, not from an illustration, so typing different inputs moves the answer exactly as the arithmetic says.

sections.title: What does the result mean?
sections.html:
The number on its own is not a judgement. These are the bands most often used when the result is quoted in a paper, a report or a label:

How to read the result
ResultBandWhat it means
below 40%Poorcontamination, wrong moisture or bad spawn run
40 – 70%Lowtypical of a first flush only
70 – 100%Goodnormal for oyster mushrooms over three flushes
above 100%Excellentachievable because the mushroom is mostly water

  • BE above 100% is possible and normal: mushrooms are about 90% water, so the fresh weight can exceed the dry substrate they grew on.

  • Always state whether the substrate weight is wet or dry. A 65% moisture block weighs nearly three times its dry matter, so the two numbers are not comparable.

  • Yield is counted over all flushes. Quoting the first flush only flatters the strain.

sections.title: What are the common mistakes?
sections.html:
These are the errors that account for almost every wrong answer people bring to this calculator:

  • Using wet substrate weight in the denominator, which halves the apparent BE.
  • Harvesting after the veil breaks — heavier, but a lower grade and a shorter shelf life.
  • Comparing species: shiitake and oyster mushrooms have very different ceilings.

sections.title: Calculators that go with this one
sections.html:
This tool answers one step of the question. The neighbouring steps have their own pages:

Seeding rate. Percent germination. Dry matter intake.

faq.q: What is a good biological efficiency for oyster mushrooms?
faq.a: 70–100% over three flushes on straw or sawdust blocks.

faq.q: How much substrate do I need for 100 kg of mushrooms?
faq.a: At 80% BE, about 125 kg of dry substrate — roughly 360 kg of wet blocks.

faq.q: What does the Mushroom Yield actually calculate?
faq.a: It returns biological efficiency, wet substrate weight, yield per block and blocks for a 100 kg harvest. Each one is derived by the formula on this page, so you can check any figure by hand.

faq.q: Do I have to fill in every box?
faq.a: Fill in the ones you know. The result boxes are computed from them, so you never enter a value the formula can derive — and if you change an input, every result updates with it.

faq.q: Why is the answer different from the one in my protocol?
faq.a: Nearly always a unit or a rounding difference. This calculator works in the units printed next to each box, keeps full precision internally and only rounds for display, so recomputing from the rounded numbers on screen can differ in the last digit.

faq.q: Can I use it with the numbers straight from a datasheet?
faq.a: Yes. Every box states its unit, and nothing is converted behind your back, so a figure copied from a datasheet, a kit insert or a protocol goes in as printed.
